intro: In Stormwind, dwarven priests are called to deepen their service to the Light. High Priestess Laurena summons promising acolytes from Dun Morogh to the Cathedral of Light. There they take on wider duties among the Alliance.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Time's come for you to head to Stormwind, friend. High Priestess Laurena in the Cathedral of Light wants to speak to you. Gotta be somethin' really good or really bad for the High Priestess to want you there personally, but I'm guessin' you've only done well for yourself and it's a good thing that she wants to speak to ya.
But don't waste too much time 'round here. I'd head there as soon as you can.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I'm glad you've arrived, friend. There are many things we will have to discuss, but more importantly is your training in the ways of the Light.
There are lessons all servants of the Light must learn. If you are ready, we'll begin discussing some of those now.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
